scope: we have conducted a series of experiments using SOMAmer®s to enrich target proteins followed by measurement using two mass spectrometry techniques
the library of 4783 SOMAmer®s were multiplexed in sets of 8 and used for enrichment of target proteins from cell lysate and conditioned media, as well as human plasma and serum
